_about: Hand-written regression pairs for app/matcher.py: invented titles, prices and identifiers modelled on how Indian marketplaces word listings. They are NOT measured on live listings, so results computed from them are a regression guard, not an accuracy figure for real stores. expected: verified = same product; candidate = plausibly the same family but must not be called verified (e.g. other storage or pack size); rejected = a different product, or an accessory / refurbished / pre-owned offer. Optional keys: source_brand, source_price, candidate_price, candidate_url, source_gtin, candidate_gtin, source_mpn, candidate_mpn, known_gap (reason; the pair is reported but not asserted).
